title: East Nashville Apartment
description:
Relax and unwind at this family friendly apartment. It’s conveniently located to all the East Nashville favorites and just a few miles from Broadway and downtown.

If you’re traveling with your family, a travel crib, Slumberpod, sound machine, and toys are available on request.

The space
You’ll have one bedroom with a queen sized bed and a queen sized sleeper sofa in the living room. There is one bathroom with a bathtub. 
The kitchen is full sized with all the essentials for cooking and Nespresso machine and drip coffee pot. There is a washer and dryer in unit. 2 dedicated driveways parking spots are available.

Guest access
Keypad entry. There are interior stairs up to the apartment.
